general.languageHint: Applies immediately — no page reload needed.
general.resetHint: Only resets theme and language — mounts and services are never touched.

media.cacheHint: Thumbnails are evicted LRU-first; clearing only removes cache files, never originals
media.ffmpegPathHint: Point to the ffmpeg binary or its install folder (e.g. C:/tools/ffmpeg/bin). When empty, ASMODAY_FFMPEG_PATH is used first, then the system PATH is probed.
media.note: FFmpeg only grabs cinema posters and encodes WebP thumbnails — never for transcoding.
media.resetHint: Only resets cache thresholds and the FFmpeg path.

security.hint: Changing the password invalidates all existing sessions immediately
security.mismatch: The two passwords do not match
security.totpHint: Scan the generated secret with any authenticator (1Password, Aegis, Google Authenticator), then enter a 6-digit code to finish enabling.
security.forgotBody: There is no "disable authentication" switch in the config. On the server terminal run
security.forgotBody2: to get a one-time password, then change it after signing in.
security.davHint: Connect with any WebDAV client (RaiDrive, Windows network drive, PhotoSync): any username, and one of the asm_-prefixed tokens below as the password. Read-only tokens can only browse and download.
security.tokenOnce: This token is shown only once — copy it now
security.recoveryHint: If you lose your authenticator, sign in with one of these codes. Each code works once — store them offline.

advanced.formHint: Saving the form rewrites the TOML (comments are lost)
advanced.sourceHint: Source mode writes the file verbatim and keeps comments
advanced.portHint: A port change takes effect after restarting the process.
advanced.baseUrlPlaceholder: Leave empty for the root path
advanced.trustProxy: Trust X-Forwarded-* / X-Real-IP from the reverse proxy
advanced.mountsHint: Without mounts only the process working directory is browsable.
advanced.protected: Mounts and external services are advanced settings: panel resets never overwrite them. Edit them here or in source mode.
advanced.servicesHint: Each entry becomes a card on the dashboard and is proxied through /proxy/<id>/.
advanced.resetHint: Default resets only apply to the General and Media panels; mounts and services must be edited by hand.

safety.HOST_ALL_INTERFACES_NO_SSL: Listening on 0.0.0.0 without SSL: the service is exposed on all interfaces. If you plan to expose it to the internet, please use a reverse proxy like Caddy/Nginx with HTTPS.
safety.PROXY_TRUST_NO_TRUSTED_IPS: auth.proxy_trust.enabled is on but trusted_ips is empty: anyone could forge headers to impersonate an admin. It has been force-disabled.
safety.PROXY_HEADERS_NO_TRUSTED_IPS: server.proxy.trust_proxy_headers is on but trusted_ips is empty: all clients share the same proxy IP.
safety.PROXY_TRUST_SKIP_2FA: auth.proxy_trust.skip_2fa is enabled: 2FA is bypassed for SSO logins.
safety.SSL_DISABLED_WITH_HTTPS_BASE: server.ssl.enabled=false but base_url looks like an https URL: please verify your deployment.
safety.RESET_PASSWORD_ENV_PRESENT: ASMODAY_RESET_PASSWORD is set: it takes effect on every start. Remove it after resetting.
